title: agent_register input
description: Register an agent key generated where the agent runs (`ekl agent init`); the agent announces itself later.

profile.description: adapter: an existing MCP server with the provider adapter; native: implements the agent interface.

key_hash.description: The lowercase hex SHA-256 of the agent key. The key itself is never sent here.

proof_key.description: Endpoint proof v2: HMAC-SHA256(agent key, 'ekl-endpoint-proof-v2') as lowercase hex, computed where the key is. Sent once; once the network holds it, v1 proofs and v1 enroll authority for the agent are refused.
